answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 31019 Country: India Title: Is it allowed to Pray Sunnath after 30 min from the Completion of Farz Namaz. Question: Is it allowed to Pray Sunnath after 30 min from the Completion of Farz Namaz. Answer ID: 31019 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 483/483/M=1432) The unnecessary delay in offering sunnah salah after fardh is makrooh. It is mentioned in hadith that the holy Prophet Muhammad (صلى الله عليه وسلم) used to make a delay only equal to this dua اللهم انت السلام الخ after salam. The gap of 30 minutes is too long. One should offer sunnah immediately after the fardh. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
